content.title: Pop Mart Shares Fall After Live-Streaming Incident About Pricing
content.summary: The Hong Kong-listed stock’s drop followed a viral clip in which a Pop Mart employee appeared to question the value of a blindbox item during a Thursday livestream, according to The Cover, a Chinese local media outlet.  On Xiaohongshu and Weibo, users criticized the company’s pricing, with one comment noting: “A string of these plastic beads costs less than two yuan, yet it’s the obsession of the young people” that has spoiled Pop Mart.  Another user chimed in with the view that the employee was telling the truth and that Pop Mart’s products are expensive.
